ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice rests on two facts. First, capability is effectively a tie here—both models are Qwen3-235B finetunes with internal eval scores well within the 2.0-point variance band on every relevant dimension, so neither has a quality edge on a math word problem. Second, this query is a closed-form, well-specified reasoning task with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria, which is precisely Lapwing's self-reported top-rated task family (retrieval/extraction/reformatting). Dunlin, by contrast, self-reports a preference for open-ended generative work, which this isn't. Since the models are equally capable, I broke the tie toward the model whose preferences best match the task type.
